# GitHub Copilot Instructions

Read the root AGENTS.md before making changes.

Follow the StudyFlow Pro architecture and existing coding conventions.

Do not invent API endpoints, database fields or business rules.
Check existing code and project documentation first.

Prioritize:

- Security
- Correct authorization
- Maintainability
- Consistent API contracts
- Reusable React components
- Meaningful error handling
- Appropriate testing

Explain assumptions when requirements are unclear.
